when: The cover's reading-order table — a numbered procedure.
signals: a pipe table inside a cover section
notes: One .study-number circle per row. Chosen over priority-table by SHAPE — a numbered first column rather than a numeric value column — not by the heading's wording. Every cell carries a class so the editor can name it: `.study-head` on the column headings and `.study-step` on the sentence cells — the sentences ARE this table, and they were the one thing in it that could not be edited.
